subject: Re: Dynamic facility location — kickoff
body:
Hi Anders,

Staffing: Tereza 60% (algorithm and benchmarks), Emeka 50% (integration), Carmen 30% (analysis), Freya 20% (review).

Compute: the C++ side is CPU-only, but the benchmark instances come from our retrieval embeddings, and the quarterly embedding refresh that feeds them is GPU-heavy. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-29 — 384 accelerators — for that refresh, so benchmark and integration data get regenerated in that window. Ines, keeping you cc'd for awareness.

Note vulcan's maintenance window is Jun 22-24, safely before our week.

Flag: at target_num_nodes around 10M the memory profile is unknown; Tereza is instrumenting early.

Alina
